start.desc: On-call queue for query-compatibility-worker. Resolve SEC-2405 and submit the smallest policy-compliant remediation with auditable dependency, advisory, implementation, and test evidence.

ticket.desc: SEC-2405: The scanner matched a reviewed prototype-pollution advisory on locutus. Determine and verify the required remediation from the cited source evidence. Inspect the failed workflow logs before changing the lockfile.

ci_failure.desc: Dependency-policy logs identify locutus 2.0.38 in package-lock.json. The scanner summary does not establish the full justification; inspect the frozen lockfile and source records.

lockfile.desc: package-lock.json pins locutus 2.0.38. Follow the scanner's reviewed advisory record and verify its referenced remediation against the current CI security endpoint.

advisory_index.desc: The scanner result resolves to reviewed record GHSA-rxrv-835q-v5mh. Open that advisory and follow its cited fix.

initial_advisory.desc: GHSA-rxrv-835q-v5mh: String.prototype.includes can be overridden to bypass the parse_str prototype-pollution guard. Affected >=2.0.12,<2.0.39; listed fixed release 2.0.39. Inspect referenced fix commit 042af9ca7fde2ff599120783e720a17f335bb01c.

false_fix.desc: Commit 042af9ca7fde2ff599120783e720a17f335bb01c: Replace the hijackable String.prototype.includes check with a RegExp.prototype.test guard. It shipped in 2.0.39; inspect that release and run the required verification.

false_summit.desc: Release 2.0.39 satisfies the original advisory record. A current-policy verification reruns the chained regression suite before accepting it.

conflict_result.desc: Verification rejected 2.0.39: the new RegExp.prototype.test guard can itself be overridden, so the earlier patch remains bypassable under the chained threat model. Follow the newer reviewed advisory GHSA-vc8f-x9pp-wf5p rather than treating the original release as terminal.

followup_advisory.desc: GHSA-vc8f-x9pp-wf5p: The 2.0.39 guard was incomplete because RegExp.prototype.test is also writable and bypassable. Affected >=2.0.39,<3.0.25; fixed in 3.0.25. It explicitly identifies the prior fix as incomplete.

final_release.desc: Release v3.0.25 resolves to 0d2402bdb92f9c59918114af9c8ba628f22e9152. Inspect the implementation and regression-test history links https://api.github.com/repos/locutusjs/locutus/commits/345a6211e1e6f939f96a7090bfeff642c9fcf9e4 and https://github.com/locutusjs/locutus/commit/345a6211e1e6f939f96a7090bfeff642c9fcf9e4 before treating the release as verified.

final_implementation_commit.desc: Commit 345a6211e1e6f939f96a7090bfeff642c9fcf9e4: Reject dangerous parsed key paths at assignment using native comparisons rather than an overridable prototype method. Review src/php/strings/parse_str.ts.

final_implementation.desc: src/php/strings/parse_str.ts: Reject dangerous parsed key paths at assignment using native comparisons rather than an overridable prototype method.

final_test_commit.desc: Commit 345a6211e1e6f939f96a7090bfeff642c9fcf9e4: regression evidence in test/custom/parse_str-prototype-pollution.vitest.ts. Inspect the test itself.

final_regression_test.desc: test/custom/parse_str-prototype-pollution.vitest.ts: Override RegExp.prototype.test and verify that crafted parse_str input no longer pollutes Object.prototype.

target.desc: CI accepted locutus 3.0.25; the incomplete-fix conflict, follow-up advisory, hardened implementation, and chained regression agree.

old_changelog.desc: Changelog headline: 2.0.39 fixes the original advisory. It predates the follow-up advisory and cannot establish current safety.

meta.loop_desc_template: Resolution page from {host}: [{level}] {n} candidate versions returned. Response includes a `next_token` for continued paging.
